methodology: REAL TELEMETRY from session_store_sql. Cloud session_id disambiguation: three executor sessions started within ~1.5s of each other (22:57:41-43 UTC); timestamp matching was ambiguous. Session confirmed by reading first user.message: SELECT user_content FROM events WHERE session_id='99c365c2-edb3-4b0b-ae24-39af79cfe139' AND type='user.message' ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 1 — content matches S3-rename architect packet headline. Previous report used 41405aae (S2N executor) in error. Query: SELECT usage_model, SUM(usage_input_tokens), SUM(usage_output_tokens), SUM(usage_cache_read_tokens), SUM(usage_cache_write_tokens), COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE session_id = '99c365c2-edb3-4b0b-ae24-39af79cfe139' AND usage_model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY usage_model.

The S7 rename itself is zero-variance; the excess cost is setup overhead, not substrate regression.
